text:
Marta: heads-up — discovered a subtle SSE resume ordering bug when our Android webview polyfill reconnects quickly. sampleapp webview shows a missing token or out-of-order tiny-deltas after a <200ms flap.
Ethan: can you paste a minimal repro?
Marta: steps: 1) open sampleapp webview 2) start stream with small tokenized deltas (ids 100..110) 3) simulate network jitter (150ms drop) 4) reconnect -> sometimes we see id 109 twice and 110 missing.
Rina: which SDK/backend combo? node backend + android webview polyfill?
Marta: node sdk on backend, android uses EventSource polyfill. Node sets both Last-Event-ID and X-Last-Event-Id; polyfill only sets last-event-id lowercase. Envoy lowercases headers, our resume check in go plumbing does Header.Get("Last-Event-Id") only.
Ethan: header casing mismatch again. But duplicate/missing token sounds like framing issue too — polyfill may split final event into two event blocks and our parser could be marking partial event complete on EOF before reconnect.
Marta: captured raw sequence: 
```
data: {"id":109,"delta":"...part1"
\n# recon
> GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood
> last-event-id: 109
\n# downstream shows resend of 109 and then 110 never applied
```
Rina: short-term fixes: 1) router middleware to canonicalize Last-Event-Id from any case 2) server-side resume should dedupe by event-id and not reapply already-seen ids 3) add unit test that feeds parser a split-final-chunk + mid-flap reconnect.
Ethan: long term: SDK parity — make all sdks include canonical header casing and a tiny compatibility shim for polyfills. Also update sampleapp webview demo to include a defensive retry-backoff to avoid immediate reconnects that trigger race.
leo: i'll add an e2e that spawns a tiny TCP server to emit split frames, force reconnect, and assert monotonic ids. i'll also add flaky-marker to CI.
ops-bot: build #5832 started for branch fix/sse-webview-resume.
Marta: i'll open PR in sampleapp with reproducible harness and note in devex changelog. thanks everyone.
Ethan: also add a short FAQ blurb for mobile integrators about header casing and polyfill behavior.
Rina: agreed, add it under SDK parity docs.
